survey: Space helmet shown three-quarter, visor facing the camera at the left. Main parts: (1) a white spherical shell; (2) a large oval amber visor set into the front of the shell and framed by a silver tube rim that follows the shell's curve; (3) a silver neck ring where the shell meets the collar; (4) a thick white cylindrical collar/base with a red stripe. The helmet sits on the collar, and the collar rests flat on a light metal panel with rivets, with a contact shadow under it. The sphere looks round, the collar looks concentric, and the helmet looks properly supported. The design is simplified but reads as a real helmet on its neck ring.

errors.where: Silver visor rim, right end at about the 3 o'clock position (where the rim meets the visor's right edge)
errors.what: The rim tube is not continuous there. It shows a cut or notch, and the visor's edge lines seem to slip past each other instead of closing into one smooth seal. There is no hinge or latch to explain the break, so the rim looks like it was joined wrong rather than built.

fix: Make the silver visor rim one continuous, unbroken oval tube that closes smoothly all the way around the amber visor, with no notch, seam or gap on the right side.
